name: Essence of the Exile

angles.text: Alchemical cauldrons and elemental transmutations often channel raw volatile magic to bind disparate essences together into solid form.
Working with elemental essences—even through bubbling cauldrons that churn molten rock—requires an understanding of the primal elemental forces at play.

aliases: what is essence of the exile
faq.answer: Essence of the Exile is a mysterious ritual performed at a bubbling cauldron. By introducing charms into the vessel's churning depths, a volatile transmutation takes place, yielding a churning lump of molten rock.
faq.q: What is the Essence of the Exile?

faq.answer: The cauldron bubbles with vapors that draw travelers close. When charms are dropped inside, they sink slowly to the bottom until a large bubble ruptures the liquid's surface, leaving behind molten stone.
faq.q: What happens when charms are placed in the cauldron?

aliases: what is produced from the cauldron
what do you get from essence of the exile
faq.answer: After the charms sink into the cauldron's steaming liquid and a large bubble bursts at the surface, a churning lump of molten rock is revealed from within the vessel.

aliases: where do i find the cauldron
faq.answer: The ritual takes place directly at a boiling cauldron whose hot vapors beckon anyone approaching it, functioning as an altar of transmutation.
faq.q: Where is the cauldron used for this ritual?

aliases: why do charms go in the cauldron
faq.answer: The charms serve as reagents consumed in the cauldron's depths. Submerging them into the heated liquid catalyzes the formation of the molten rock.
faq.q: Why are charms placed into the cauldron?

faq.answer: The bubbling liquid and beckoning vapors indicate an active, potent chemical or elemental reaction brewing within the vessel, primed to transform whatever enters its depths.
faq.q: Why is the cauldron constantly bubbling?

sections.body: Essence of the Exile involves a strange transmutation centered around a mysterious, bubbling cauldron. The vessel emits beckoning vapors, tempting travelers to investigate its churning depths. It functions as an elemental vessel capable of reacting intensely with specific enchanted charms.
sections.title: A Beckoning Cauldron

sections.body: When the required charms are submerged into the cauldron, they sink slowly toward the bottom. As the mixture reacts, a large bubble rises through the viscous liquid and ruptures, revealing a churning lump of molten rock forged from the combined materials.
sections.title: The Molten Crucible

summary: Essence of the Exile is a mysterious transmutation ritual centered on a bubbling, vapor-spewing cauldron. By introducing charms into its liquid depths, travelers trigger a violent reaction that produces a churning lump of molten rock. It represents a potent convergence of volatile reagents and elemental power.
attribution: In-game quest text: Essence of the Exile
